title: Unexpected blending in SubViewport with `transparent_bg` & `use_hdr_2d`
body: ### Tested versions v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1] ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Ubuntu 25.10 25.10 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7600 XT (RADV NAVI33) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700K CPU @ 4.20GHz (8 threads) - 31.29 GiB memory ### Issue description When combining `transparent_bg` & `use_hdr_2d` on a SubViewport, a texture with a CanvasItemMaterial `blend_mode` set to Add or Subtract does not match an identical setup in the root viewport - even when drawn on an opaque background. I reckon that it is a limitation that the texture cannot blend with the transparent part of the sub viewport's background. However, the part of the texture that is drawn onto the blue background appearing different doesn't seem right and unfortunately, makes any application of additive blending in a SubViewport with this setup unusable. There is a number of similar issues, yet not quite duplicates from what I can tell. #99715, #88603 , #20069, #32615, #84787 These are mostly about alpha in transparent viewports, but aren't pertaining to blend mode or HDR. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a clean project. 2. Enable `rendering/viewport/hdr_2d` in the Project Settings (root viewport HDR). 3. Create a scene within which you render a SubViewport through a ViewportTexture or ViewportContainer. 4. Enable both `transparent_bg` and `use_hdr_2d` on the SubViewport. 5. Both in the root viewport and the sub viewport, add identical sprites with a CanvasItemMaterial that has set blend mode set to Add. Sample: 6. I recommend adding some colored Polygon2D as background to make the issue apparent. 7. Note that the result we see rendered in the sub viewport is not matching the result we see in the root viewport. The exact setup from the screenshot above can be found in the attached MRP. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [godot_4_viewport_blend_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23982572/godot_4_viewport_blend_bug.zip)
